top_signals.title: Ethan Allen CEO Responds to Activist Push
top_signals.summary: Activist investor Douglas Bergeron is pushing to replace Ethan Allen’s entire board, arguing the furniture maker needs an overhaul of its leadership and governance. Ethan Allen Chairman & CEO Farooq Kathwari responds to the activist campaign on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
